name: scroll-curtain-reveal
title: Scroll Curtain Reveal
description: A dual-leaf curtain mechanism that parts horizontally across the viewport as the user scrolls, unveiling underlying content.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Split
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Mechanical
Typography: Serif Display
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Wheel Scrubbed Reveal: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
